full_judgment: 10. The learned Advocate further submits that the investigating officer namely Moloy Kumar Saha has not been even cited as a witness in the charge sheet that vital witnesses have been withheld and non-examination of those witnesses raises presumption against the prosecution to the effect that had they been examined they would not have supported the prosecution case, but the trial court failed to consider the same, as such, the impugned order of conviction is liable to be aside.
